issue: GEM Parent field for Yingkou is self-referential: Parent = 'Zhongjiao Yingkou Liquefied Natural Gas Co Ltd [100.0%]', i.e. the project SPV listed as its own parent. Public sources say the SPV (China Communications Yingkou LNG Co Ltd, 中交营口LNG) is a JV: China Communications Urban and Rural Energy (CURE, 中交城乡能源, a wholly-owned subsidiary of state-owned China Communications Construction Co / CCCC) holding the majority, with Hebei Shenneng Gas Co Ltd (河北燊能燃气) holding 25%. The true ultimate parent (CCCC, via CURE) plus Hebei Shenneng are not reflected. entity_lookup for 'China Communications Urban and Rural Energy' returned no existing GEM entity (inconclusive/generic-only).
suggested_action: Researcher to verify the equity split and set Parent to CURE/CCCC (majority) + Hebei Shenneng Gas (25%), creating the CURE entity if confirmed absent from the GEM entity system. Source: S&P Global (paywalled, 403 on verifier) + Mysteel/offshore-technology corroborate CCCC/CURE + Hebei Shenneng. Note 'Zhongjiao' = pinyin for 中交 = China Communications, so the owner romanization is correct; only the parent chain needs refinement.
